purpose: Qualify literal static member reads on variable receivers through existing invocation-owned member semantics. Emission and execution are separate evidence.

validation.independentReview: One fresh read-only static_variable_member_review pass: no actionable P0-P3 findings. Selection, expression binder, IR effects, lowering, backend receiver evaluation, runtime binder and statement-error ownership inspected; no tests run by reviewer.
limits: Only literal static member names on variable receivers gain selection. Existing dynamic-name forms retain their prior owner; arbitrary new receiver expression shapes are not admitted by this rule.

Rights calculation has no filesystem or ACL mutation. Generic bits are supplied as actual enum objects through Enum.ToObject because original PowerShell rejects undefined enum integer casts. The authored -as conversion returns null for the all-bits case; generated behavior matches.

Tests cover actual Type values, null/non-Type receivers, missing MaxValue, StrictMode off/2, rebinding, error identity/positions and finally. Undefined/scoped receiver storage and static getter callbacks that mutate session state or throw have no new dedicated differential cases.

Focused artifacts qualify Windows PowerShell 5.1/net472 and PowerShell 7/net10.0. Full five-packet census is net10.0 only. No full-module administration, other platform, performance, package or release proof.

Initial 2/4 run failed in the original-only harness on undefined integer enum casts and invalid Set-StrictMode -Version 0; corrected input construction and StrictMode setup passed 10/10. No production correction or weakened contract followed.
